html:
Explore Da Nang Leaf Village, you will encounter a peaceful, rustic scene very close to nature, this is one of the new attractions in Da Nang with many unique experiences amidst the majestic and cool mountain scenery and many attractive entertainment games.

Surrounded by the vast mountain scenery of rivers and streams, you can take a walk to watch the river, or the sunset looks like a beautiful natural painting.

If you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang, visitors should visit Leaf Village to feel the peaceful scene, Leaf Village has just opened to visitors in March this year, so it still retains its original beauty. Leaf Village & Farm is a beautiful check-in spot chosen by many tourists when coming to Da Nang, especially young people to visit and experience.

Lang La is located in the middle of a cool green space, standing out in the wild scenery and is a destination for those who love peaceful scenery and relaxation. Here, there are diverse eco-tourism areas, you will have a fun vacation with the most peaceful scenery, especially the resorts are also combined closely with nature.

Coming to Lang La, you will be able to freely check in in the colorful flower garden, visit the cool green farm, visit the zoo and experience the bungalow resort or soak in the stream or by the swimming pool…

Here, there are many fun and entertaining activities that many tourists enjoy such as: picking up chicken eggs, fishing, making campfires… or folk games, listening to the dances and songs of the Central region.

In addition, Lang La also has a separate entertainment area for children and adults in a spacious, airy space that is very close to nature, so this place is gradually becoming an ideal destination for all when traveling Da Nang tour to visit Lang La to experience the newest things that this place brings to visitors.

In addition to the vibrant entertainment activities, Lang La is also a space to connect love, spend the most relaxing moments together, and enjoy dishes with rustic cuisine, and admire the peaceful natural scenery.
